sections.heading: What "household income" means here
sections.intro: Medi-Cal, Covered California, the premium tax credit, and California's $580 work-rule test all use the same tax-based measure of income.

sections.heading: How your three income streams are treated
The $580 test, in detail
sections.intro: This is the single most important rule for you. You have no earned income, so the $580 test and the 80-hour options are the two ways to satisfy the 2027 requirement.
